relics.name: Wick's Drawing
relics.lore: A crayon fish with too many legs. On the back, in a grown-up's handwriting: 'He draws them before they come.'

relics.name: The Keeper's Kettle
relics.lore: Dented tin, a rope handle. It has sat on a bare rock for twelve winters and it is warm. It is always nearly boiling.
